Keshon Gilbert.note: Gilbert (knee) is out for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.

Asa Newell.note: Newell (toe)  is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

Jock Landale.note: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nets.

Mouhamed Gueye.note: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Henri Veesaar.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Day'Ron Sharpe.note: Sharpe registered 15 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 13 rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes in Sunday's 98-90 win over the Pacers.

Egor Demin.note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

Jaylon Tyson.note: Tyson (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

Sam Merrill.note: Merrill (elbow) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

Jarrett Allen.note: Allen (knee) is out for Saturday's game against the Knicks

Julian Strawther.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

Kristaps Porzingis.note: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

Moses Moody.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Jimmy Butler III.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Clint Capela.note: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.

Steven Adams.note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

Tyrese Haliburton.note: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

Johnny Furphy.note: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

Ben Sheppard.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

Josh Hart.note: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.

Jaylin Williams.note: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

Thomas Sorber.note: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.

Cason Wallace.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

Chet Holmgren.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

Jalen Williams.note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

Desmond Bane.note: Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.

Jonathan Isaac.note: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.

Jalen Suggs.note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Paolo Banchero.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Noah Penda.note: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

Rasheer Fleming.note: Fleming (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Rockets.

Jordan Goodwin.note: Goodwin (calf) is doubtful for Saturday's game against the Rockets.

Mark Williams.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Robert Williams III.note: Williams (rest) won't play in Saturday's game against the Spurs.

Vit Krejci.note: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Ja Morant.note: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

Shaedon Sharpe.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Tobias Harris.note: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

Jayden Quaintance.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

Anthony Davis.note: Davis (ankle) won't play Saturday against the Thunder.

Reece Beekman.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

Tristan Vukcevic.note: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.

Justin Champagnie.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Jamir Watkins.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
